Notes: DETECT immunity filter (owner VRM-coupling concern 2026-07-15): 100n on the 10k-source analog identity line; ~1ms settle, irrelevant to detection; kills near-field pickup.
Power-entry TVS (owner GO 2026-07-15): the J_PWR feed arrives over a chassis cable from the 24-pin; 5V working, clamps line transients. DETECT-pin ESD posture extended to the power entry.

Per-port RJ45-VCC polyfuse (owner ruling 2026-07-15): fault isolation -- a shorted patch cable or failed module trips ONE port instead of browning out the shared 5VSB system (the TPS2121 limit is total, not per-port). 0805 PTC, 500mA hold, 6V rated. ~150mV drop at load absorbed by module LDO headroom.

MEZZANINE (OQ-77) Hub side, power segment. Segmented mezz per docs/mezz-structural-segments-2026-07-22.md Appendix A (owner GO 2026-07-22); supersedes the 2026-07-15 column-paired 2x08 J6 map (flip-invariance premise retired by the 2026-07-19 no-flip ruling -- Hub sits over the 24-pin normally, not flipped). THT + DNP, facing/assembly per the stack doc. Pins 1/3/5=+5VSB, 2/4/6=GND. 5V pins tie to +5VSB rail: the 24-pin feeds PRE-MUXED +5V_SYS; the Hub's TPS2121s block reverse.

MEZZANINE (OQ-77) Hub side, comms segment. Segmented mezz per docs/mezz-structural-segments-2026-07-22.md Appendix A (owner GO 2026-07-22); supersedes the 2026-07-15 column-paired 2x08 J6 map. THT + DNP. Pins 1/2/7/8=GND, 3=CAN_H, 5=CAN_L; pins 4/6 (STREAM_P/STREAM_N) intentionally unconnected -- Standard-tier hub carries no RS-485 pair, forward-compat provision only, matches the 24-pin side's unconnected STREAM pads.

MEZZANINE (OQ-77) Hub side, ID segment. Segmented mezz per docs/mezz-structural-segments-2026-07-22.md Appendix A (owner GO 2026-07-22); supersedes the 2026-07-15 column-paired 2x08 J6 map. THT + DNP. Pin 1=DETECT (ties to /DETECT1, the hub port-1 detect line -- role match is what mates, not the literal name), 2/4=GND; pin 3 (RSVD) intentionally unconnected -- reserved spare, no net on this board.
